Chronic Medical Treatment
Oral preparations of sodium phenylbutyrate, sodium benzoate, 
citrulline, and arginine are used routinely for maintaining am-
monia homeostasis. Liver transplantation for patients with urea
cycle defects has been used, typically in the more severe forms
of the disease.
Nutrition Therapy for Urea Cycle Disorders
Acute Nutrition Intervention Initial treatment

infants are dehydrated at presentation due to anorexia and
